# Epic: Mobile and reminders

**Slug:** mobile-and-reminders
**Status:** draft

## Goal

The reminder helper for notifications while the app is closed and native mobile screens for quick entry and glance.

## Scope

- Plan items and reminder helper
- Native iOS and Android quick entry

## Out of Scope

- Full desktop parity on mobile
